objective.title: Freeze transfer architecture and localization boundary

declared.summary: Freeze the initial Math transfer architecture: preserve inherited quantity package identities, replace the dw.localization dependency with passive BCL-only metadata, split pure UnitConverter semantics from AURA presentation, and ready the cross-agent exchange contract.
declared.value: Turns the authorized AURA source corpus into a deterministic transfer manifest without copying source yet, giving M1 exact package/file boundaries while keeping localization and host policy outside Math.
debtChanges: Actual AURA source copying remains deferred to M1 and must re-check every pinned SHA-256 before transfer.
UnitConverter is a behavioral adaptation source rather than a mandatory raw-file copy; AURA-facing errors, culture, projection, permissions, and host policy remain external.
declared.nextAction: Use M0-W02-C03 to finalize the owner-mediated exchange/request protocol and AURA baseline request, then close M0 without performing cross-repository writes.

achievements.achievement: The transfer-architecture question is bounded to inherited package identities, standalone dependency structure, localization ownership, and UnitConverter separation.
Pinned AURA sources and tests are classified by exact SHA-256 into direct transfer, behavioral adaptation, and retained host-localization responsibilities.

The package and localization decision preserves dw.quantities identities, rejects a dw.localization dependency, and assigns pure conversion semantics to Math while host presentation remains AURA-owned.
The initial transfer contract is frozen with three inherited package identities, exact target roots, passive localization metadata, and a standalone package graph.
The integration-boundary question explicitly compares passive Math metadata with wholesale localization transfer and fixes external API preservation as a constraint.
The manifest proves 20 pinned direct transfer entries, eight localization/presentation files retained in AURA, and one UnitConverter behavioral adaptation source.
The boundary decision records no sibling checkout dependency, no dw.localization transfer, no Decision/MCDM API change, and mandatory source-drift reconciliation.
The localization and integration boundary is qualified without moving host presentation policy or changing external repositories.
M0-W02-C02 is complete with package identities, localization treatment, UnitConverter ownership, and the exact transfer manifest frozen for later M1 extraction.
